speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (a) whether it is compulsory for wet market stallholders to display their prices prominently; (b) if so, how does the Ministry enforce this; and (c) how many stallholders have been found to be in breach of such regulations over the past five years.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Regardless of the requirement, it is a good practice for stallholders to be transparent about their prices so that consumers will have greater peace of mind when patronising them and can make more informed choices.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Would the Ministry consider a campaign to put up posters in some of these wet markets to educate consumers that stallholders are expected to display these prices and perhaps to have a hotline number they can call, if there are stallholders who are consistently not displaying prices?

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: Anyone is free to contact us to give us feedback on the display of food prices and any other issues with regard to hawker centres.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: I wish to highlight that we do understand that, for market stalls, there are challenges for them in fulfilling this requirement.
